name: get_robust_list
synopsis: long syscall(SYS_get_robust_list, int pid, struct robust_list_head **head_ptr, size_t *len_ptr);
long syscall(SYS_set_robust_list, struct robust_list_head *head, size_t len);
description: The get_robust_list() system call retrieves the head of the robust futex list for a specified thread. It allows the kernel to notify waiting threads if the owner of a futex terminates or executes a new program unexpectedly.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: The thread ID of the thread whose robust futex list is to be retrieved; if 0, the calling thread's list is used.

parameters.name: head_ptr
parameters.description: Pointer to a location where the address of the robust futex list head will be stored.

parameters.name: len_ptr
parameters.description: Pointer to a size_t where the size of the object pointed to by *head_ptr will be stored.

return_value.failure: Returns an error code on failure

errors.description: The head of the robust futex list can’t be stored at the location head.
The calling process does not have permission to see the robust futex list of the thread with the thread ID pid, and does not have the CAP_SYS_PTRACE capability.
No thread with the thread ID pid could be found.
